name: Craft Power Stone [Psionic] [Item Creation]
body:
You can create power stones to store psionic powers.

Prerequisite(s): Manifester level 1st.

Benefit(s): You can create a power stone of any power that you know. Encoding a power stone takes one day for each 1,000 gp in its base price.
